# Checklist — Ray-Ban Meta Gen 1 / Gen 2

**Product honesty:** These glasses do **not** get SPECTOR text on the lenses in our current product story. SPECTOR is a **phone (or computer) rehearsal** tool while you wear the glasses.

Please do **not** treat this as an on-lens teleprompter test.

Time: ~20–40 minutes. Reply by email using the feedback headings you were sent.

---

## Setup

1. On your **phone** (or computer), open https://www.spectorlabs.io  
2. Use **Try Spector free** or paste a short script and open the player.  
3. Put on your Ray-Ban Meta Gen 1 or Gen 2.  
4. Optional: note Meta AI app version and glasses model string.

---

## Tests

For each item, note pass/fail and a one-line observation.

### A. Phone rehearsal (required)

| # | Task | Pass? | Notes |
|---|------|-------|-------|
| A1 | SPECTOR player opens and plays on the phone/computer | | |
| A2 | You can read the active line at Normal speed | | |
| A3 | Commas/periods feel usable (or not) while speaking a short paragraph | | |
| A4 | You can rehearse for ~2 minutes without losing place | | |

### B. Speaking while using SPECTOR (required)

| # | Task | Pass? | Notes |
|---|------|-------|-------|
| B1 | Speak aloud while SPECTOR advances on the phone | | |
| B2 | Eyes can look up from the phone when needed without losing the thread | | |

### C. Hardware controls (optional — report honestly)

**Unverified** whether temple/touch events reach SPECTOR. If nothing happens, that is a useful result.

| # | Task | Anything reach SPECTOR? | Notes |
|---|------|-------------------------|-------|
| C1 | Single temple / touch action while player is open | Yes / No / Unsure | |
| C2 | Double-tap or other gesture (if your model has one) | Yes / No / Unsure | |

### D. Modes (optional)

| # | Task | Pass? | Notes |
|---|------|-------|-------|
| D1 | Try **Focus** mode — more stable read? | | |
| D2 | Try **Comfort** mode on phone — help or distract? | | |

---

## Send back

Use the feedback template headings: hardware model, what you attempted, what worked, what failed, controls, readability/comfort, bugs, screenshots/video if any, comments.

Thank you — this helps us avoid false hardware claims.
